paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss comparison between two models, Vanilla and SepLLM, across varying computation costs measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.00 to 1.25, marked in intervals of 0.25. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," also has a linear scale, with values ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, marked in intervals of 0.05. The plot features two lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing the Vanilla model and a red line with circle markers representing the SepLLM model. The purple line starts at approximately 2.74 and decreases steadily to around 2.52, with a relatively consistent downward trend. The red line begins at about 2.73 and also decreases steadily to approximately 2.48, showing a similar downward trend.
